item.title: Gwinnett County chair pitches sustainable growth, redevelopment
item.description: Gwinnett County Chair Nicole Love Hendrickson announced a redevelopment opportunity at the corner of Jimmy Carter Boulevard and Interstate 85, and highlighted the county's commitment to economic stability, public safety, and environmental sustainability. item.title: Upscale resale event Tossed Out Treasures returns to Sandy Springs
item.description: The Sandy Springs Society's 33rd Annual Tossed Out Treasures upscale resale event on March 13-15 offers shoppers a unique opportunity to find high-end items while supporting local nonprofits, with proceeds from the event benefiting area organizations through the Society's annual grant program. The post Upscale resale event Tossed Out Treasures returns to Sandy Springs appeared first on Rough Draft Atlanta.

item.title: North Fulton cities gear up for crucial service delivery negotiations with Fulton County
item.description: The North Fulton Municipal Association is preparing for negotiations with Fulton County to determine how the local governments will share responsibility for service delivery and its cost, with topics including the county's main jail, animal control, and the City of Atlanta's water rates. The post North Fulton cities gear up for crucial service delivery negotiations with Fulton County appeared first on Rough Draft Atlanta.

item.title: NBA shuts down Hawks’ Magic City Night after league backlash
item.description: The NBA canceled the Atlanta Hawks' planned Magic City Night promotion due to widespread concern from across the league about the event's ties to the city's well-known strip club. The post NBA shuts down Hawks’ Magic City Night after league backlash appeared first on Rough Draft Atlanta.

item.title: U.S.-Israel-Iran War: Objectives and Conclusions
item.description: The U.S. and Israel have a common motivation to end Iran's hostile political behavior, which has caused instability in the Middle East and disrupted gas and oil markets, and the war could result in a complete overhaul of the Iranian regime or a less than positive outcome that could require another war to rein in Iran.
